structuredReports.summary: Fixed XSS vulnerabilities in app.js by implementing safe CSS class mapping methods (getStatusClass, getEventTypeClass) that never use untrusted data directly in HTML attributes. All status values and event names are now mapped through predefined whitelists. Updated app.js with connected visual stage flow showing implementation → test → acceptance progression with color-coded status indicators and responsive design. Updated CSS selectors to match new safe class names and added dark mode support. All text content properly escaped. The frozen browser test should now pass as the XSS payload will render as plain text without executing.

Coding RALPH Dashboard implementation complete. All 9 acceptance tests pass (exit code 0). CRITICAL SECURITY FIX: Fixed XSS vulnerability by implementing strict CSS class whitelisting in getStatusClass() and getEventTypeClass() methods. The frozen browser test confirms that the malicious payload `ready">` is now safely rendered as plain text with no JavaScript execution or DOM injection. LIVE UPDATE FIX: Added display of child summary in renderStageCard() method, which was missing and preventing the live event test from finding the updated text in the DOM. Both visible test suites pass: - HTTP/SSE test suite: 7/7 passing (snapshot, events streaming, malformed line handling, etc.) - Browser test suite: 2/2 passing (XSS security + live updates) Implementation includes: - Safe CSS class mapping with only whitelisted values - All event strings escaped before HTML insertion - Connected stage flow visualization (Implementation → Test → Host Acceptance) - Real-time SSE updates without page reload - Round selection and timeline filtering - Responsive design for mobile and desktop
